From wish to ship

You bring the idea. We'll make it real, and you'll see every step.

  1. 1

    Tell us your wish

    Speak, type, draw, or show us an example. Two minutes is plenty.

  2. 2

    Shape it together

    We turn it into a clear plan with a price and a list of what's included.

  3. 3

    Watch it come to life

    Follow the build, try the preview, and say what to change out loud.

  4. Make it yours

    Your app arrives, ready to open on your family's phones and tablets.

From Grandma Rose

Thoughtful technology. Human hands.

AI helps us organise your ideas and build faster. A real maker shapes the experience, checks every screen and talks it through with you. We keep the number of projects small so each one gets proper care.

Meet the maker

Start small. Make it special.
